_evidence: 0x552762 scans the active bit (+0x4c bit 0) of the 0x140 x 0xe0-byte records at 0x854414 (dword 0x854460 + k*0xe0) for the first free record; clc + index when one is free, stc when all 0x140 are in use. The array is zero in the image (record 0 always free). prefix: the first n records are active (odd values) and the rest free, n in {0,1,2,5,0x13f,0x140,0x140}, so the first-free position and the all-in-use exit both occur.
